aim.en: By the end of the session you can build a table of measures in which every row names its instrument and its uncertainty — for a hand and for a building — and you can say which measured values shut which hand out of your object.
aim.sr: Na kraju časa umeš da napraviš tabelu mera u kojoj svaki red navodi instrument i nesigurnost — za ruku i za zgradu — i umeš da kažeš koje izmerene vrednosti isključuju koju ruku iz tvog predmeta.

bring.en: The object from the last two weeks — prototype or the everyday object you chose to redesign. It travels to every session now.
bring.sr: Predmet iz prethodne dve nedelje — prototip ili svakodnevni predmet koji si izabrao za prepravku. Od sada ide na svaki čas.

bring.en: A tape or a ruler, and a string for the grip: the string follows the hand where the ruler cannot.
bring.sr: Metar ili lenjir, i konac za hvat: konac prati ruku tamo gde lenjir ne može.

bring.en: One sheet of A3. Both halves of the sheet are born this week: the hand above, the faculty below.
bring.sr: Jedan list A3. Ove nedelje nastaju oba dela lista: ruka gore, fakultet dole.

items.en: The students' works were photographed in class: 29 entries, recorded in shooting order. The number beside each entry counts photographs — the sequence starts with the box and the degree photographs and ends with the picture of the environment in which a user tries the prototype.
items.sr: Radovi studenata fotografisani su na času: 29 zapisa, zapisivan redom slikanja. Broj uz svaki zapis je broj fotografija u nizu — niz počinje kutijom odnosno slikama sa diplomskih, a završava se slikom iz okruženja u kome korisnica proba prototip.

items.en: Confirmed on 18 October 2026: Muzička kutija, Zmijica, Sudoku and „Castle” already belong to the first wave of prototypes.
items.sr: Potvrđeno 18.10.2026: Muzička kutija, Zmijica, Sudoku i „Castle” već su u prvom talasu prototipa.

items.en: Entries 17–20 await the students' confirmation; the unclear parts are marked on the list page, for the students to come forward with corrections.
items.sr: Zapisi 17–20 čekaju potvrdu studenata; nejasni delovi su označeni na strani spiska, da se studenti jave sa ispravkama.

items.en: From the association: the director praised the student prototypes, the users' wish to try them was clear, and a possible competition run by the association was mentioned.
items.sr: Iz udruženja: direktor je pohvalio studentske prototipe, primetna je želja korisnika da ih isprobavaju, i pomenut je mogući konkurs od strane udruženja.

items.en: The photographs are still on the teacher's phone — not yet transferred; the list page and the work register wait for them.
items.sr: Fotografije su još na telefonu nastavnika — nisu prenete; strana spiska i registar radova ih čekaju.

text.en: Week 3 — the list of the third class: 29 works in shooting order, the association's reading and the questions that wait for clarification
text.sr: Nedelja 3 — spisak radova trećeg časa: 29 radova redom slikanja, analiza iz udruženja i pitanja koja čekaju razjašnjenje

text.en: The hand is the first object we measure
text.sr: Ruka je prvi objekat koji merimo

text.en: For two weeks the toy was judged by principles and by material. This week it is judged by hands — the smallest, the largest and the one you design for. A hand is measured, never simulated: three real hands, five measures each, every row with its instrument and its uncertainty.
text.sr: Dve nedelje igračka se sudila po principima i po materijalu. Ove nedelje sudi joj ruka — najmanja, najveća i ona za koju projektuješ. Ruka se meri, nikad ne simulira: tri stvarne ruke, po pet mera, svaki red sa instrumentom i nesigurnošću.

text.en: The same discipline at two scales: above, the hand around your object at 1:1 or 1:2; below, the first rows of the faculty table — a door, a corridor, a handle. Next week the Rulebook asks for those numbers by article.
text.sr: Ista disciplina na dve razmere: gore, ruka oko tvog predmeta u 1:1 ili 1:2; dole, prvi redovi tabele fakulteta — vrata, hodnik, kvaka. Sledeće nedelje Pravilnik pita za te brojeve po članu.

text.en: From the hand to the building

A door clear width and a grip diameter are the same kind of fact: a number, an instrument, an uncertainty. The course moves between them all semester — the object in the hand and the building around the hand.
text.sr: Svetla širina vrata i prečnik hvata su ista vrsta činjenice: broj, instrument, nesigurnost. Predmet se ceo semestar kreće između njih — predmet u ruci i zgrada oko ruke.

sta.en: First draft: the faculty measurement as the whole sheet.
sta.sr: Prvi nacrt: merenje fakulteta kao ceo list.

sta.en: Redirected: the hand that holds it is the upper half (continues the prototype; works without one), the faculty table is the lower half. The week 4 Rulebook check keeps its input. The first draft stays in the repository history.
sta.sr: Preusmereno: Ruka koja drži je gornji deo (nastavlja prototip; radi i bez njega), tabela fakulteta donji deo. Provera po Pravilniku u 4. nedelji zadržava svoj ulaz. Prvi nacrt ostaje u istoriji repozitorijuma.

sta.en: Held on 16 October 2026 and published: the recorded-after-class section and the link to the third-class list page were added; the date is confirmed.
sta.sr: Održano 16.10.2026. i objavljeno: dopunjen je odeljak „Zapisano posle časa” i veza na stranu spiska radova trećeg časa; datum je potvrđen.
